title: The extinguisher's pressure gauge
lines: A full extinguisher doesn't mean a working one.
Without the right pressure, it simply won't spray.
So before work, take a look at the gauge.
Needle in the green? It is ready.
In the red or yellow? Replace or recharge it.
One second of looking, peace of mind all day.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
